title: Minkah Fitzpatrick calls defensive struggles a case of "Jets being Jets"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Minkah Fitzpatrick calls defensive struggles a case of "Jets being Jets"
sources.description: The Jets had a nine-point lead over the Raiders with under nine minutes to play in the third quarter on Sunday, but the Raiders outscored them 17-3 over the rest of the game to snap a four-game losing streak.
